summary_html: **CAPTA §5106a(c)** requires every state to maintain **Citizen Review Panels** that evaluate CPS policies. Project Milk Carton checks whether panels are active, independent, and publicly reporting.

case_law.method: v1.1.0 case-law rebuild: authorities selected per decision point, each opinion retrieved from CourtListener and read; holding and quote taken from the opinion text; independently re-verified before release. Previous keyword-matched Justia listings were removed.

key_cases.holding: The SJC affirmed termination, holding that the department discharged its duty to strengthen and encourage the family unit where it worked diligently without success and the additional services the mother sought would not have solved her chronic problems, and that a court appointed special advocate appointed as guardian ad litem may testify and submit a report.
key_cases.relevance: The court's endorsement of trained citizen volunteers (CASAs) as officers of the court is the closest Massachusetts analogue to structured citizen oversight of child welfare cases.
key_cases.quote: Mary’s argument that the department failed to fulfil its duty to strengthen and encourage the family unit lacks merit.

key_cases.case_name: People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals, Inc. v. Department of Agricultural Resources
key_cases.holding: The SJC construed the public safety and privacy exemptions to the public records law, holding that the statutes favor disclosure by presuming records are public and placing on the custodian the burden of proving with specificity that an exemption applies.
key_cases.relevance: Citizen review of agency performance depends on the disclosure presumption PETA articulates.
key_cases.quote: Together, these statutes, and our cases interpreting them, favor disclosure of public records in two primary ways.
